subject: Renewal: Priority SLO uplift & onramp — proposed options
messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha.m@crestline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal request — priority SLO uplift and throughput increase

Hi Kimberly,

We’re starting our renewal discussions for the platform contract that expires Nov 15. Usage has spiked and the product team wants to lock in predictable latency and capacity going into next year. High level asks: 
- Priority response SLA (p95 target) at ~120ms for US region for inference (current p95 ~450ms on peak).
- Reserved capacity uplift from our current 4-Pool commit to 12 GPUs (phased over 60 days).
- 12-month term (we prefer annual commit).

Procurement wants a clear mutual action plan, cost options (monthly vs annual), and a draft addendum we can circulate internally. I attached a usage export for Q3 to help sizing.

Timeline: we’d like commercial terms and SLO language in draft by Sep 22 so legal can review the week of Sep 27.

Can you loop in ops/solutions so we can validate the onramp timeline?

Thanks,
Asha
Senior Engineering Manager
Crestline Financial

[Attachment: crestline_usage_q3.csv]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.m@crestline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request — priority SLO uplift and throughput increase

Hi Asha — thanks, and appreciate the export.

High-level plan I propose:
1) Phased capacity onramp: reserve 8 GPUs immediately on a 12-month annual commit, add additional 4 GPUs (total 12) after a 60-day stabilization window.
2) Premium SLO addendum: formalize p95 latency objective, target uptime & escalation windows (we'll provide an addendum draft).
3) Operational prep: prewarming KV cache + traffic shaping during cutoff windows to protect tail latency.
4) Commercial options: monthly vs annual pricing tiers (I’ll have Marissa send numbers).

Marissa — can you pull the two commercial options (monthly true-up and annual commit with a % discount) and a proposed migration credit?
Mateo — can you confirm a realistic ops onramp timeline and any prerequisites for prewarming/packaging models?

Attaching a working addendum skeleton so legal has something to chew on. I’ll consolidate and send a recommended single-path option to Asha and Enrique by EOD Mon (Sep 21) unless you advise otherwise.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0197

[Attachment: draft_addendum_v1.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request — commercial options

Kimberly / Mateo — quick pricing options based on the Q3 export: 

Option A — Monthly (no long-term discount):
- Start: reserve 8 GPUs, monthly invoice true-up for peak consumption beyond commit.
- Unit economics: $X per vGPU-hour (baseline), estimated monthly spend $85k -> forecasted annual run-rate $1.02M.

Option B — Annual commit (preferred):
- Annual commit for 12 months at an 8-GPU baseline with step-up to 12 GPUs at day 60.
- 12% discount vs list on token usage; estimated effective annual spend $900k.
- We can offer a one-time migration credit of $25k (applied to first invoice) to offset onboarding costs.

Next steps I recommend: include the migration credit in the addendum and present Option B as the recommended route — better unit economics and operational predictability.

Attached pricing breakout (sensitive).

Marissa
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request — ops timeline and readiness

Thanks — technical notes from infra/solutions: 
- Onboarding estimate: 3 weeks for staging + 1 week for controlled roll to production (total ~4 weeks) given current model footprints.
- Prewarm steps: snapshot KV cache, seed hot prefixes, apply continuous batching policy during peak windows.
- Risk & rollback: recommend a canary on 10% traffic during first 72 hours after step-up; fallback to previous commit if tail latency degrades >25% p95.
- Suggested burst config: reserve a small burst pool (20% above baseline) for the first 14 days.

I attached a short ops checklist and the runbook stub for the onramp. If legal requires more specific SLI measurement text we can produce a monitoring appendix.

Mateo
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ops_runbook.md]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.m@crestline.com>, Enrique Sosa <enrique.sosa@crestline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request — priority SLO uplift and throughput increase

Asha / Enrique — thanks for the clear asks and the usage export. Below is the consolidated recommendation and next steps so procurement/legal have a single package to review.

Recommended path (single, recommended option):
- Commercial: Annual commit (12 month) with immediate reservation of 8 GPUs and step-up to 12 GPUs at day 60. 12% discount applied; migration credit $25k applied to invoice 1. Estimated net annual spend: ~$900k. (see attached pricing sheet)
- SLA & SLO: Premium addendum to include p95 latency target (measured at the inference edge for US region), uptime targets, support response windows, and a monitoring appendix.
- Ops onramp: 3-week staging + 1-week ramp; 10% canary for first 72 hours; burst pool 20% for 14 days.
- Legal/Procurement timeline: We will issue a formal addendum via DocuSign once you confirm the path. Target signature window: Sep 28 - Oct 4; proposed start date Oct 1 (billing aligns with signature).

Attachments: refined addendum (v2) + pricing. DocuSign link below for the single-path addendum once you confirm.

Action items:
- Asha / Enrique: confirm you want to proceed with the recommended path by EOD Thu (Sep 23) so we can route to legal.
- Marissa: once Asha confirms, generate final addendum with the migration credit line item.
- Mateo: prepare production monitoring appendix for the addendum.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-addendum

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0197

[Attachment: draft_addendum_v2.pdf]

From: Asha Mehta <asha.m@crestline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Enrique Sosa <enrique.sosa@crestline.com>
Cc: legal@crestline.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request — priority SLO uplift and throughput increase

Kimberly — thanks for the fast consolidation and the options. Crestline will proceed with the recommended path (annual commit -> step to 12 GPUs).

Please:
- Loop in our legal team (cc’d) to get the addendum reviewed — they may request tighter SLA measurement language and a data residency clause.
- Confirm start date Oct 1 and we’ll expect the DocuSign packet.

Enrique and I will circulate to procurement this afternoon.

Asha
